create_trainer_instance: create a Trainer instance with a CFM model, learning rate, and checkpoint path for TTS training
run_training_loop: run the training loop with a dataset, epochs, batch size, and gradient accumulation for TTS model
save_model_checkpoint: save a model checkpoint with optimizer state, EMA state, and scheduler state to disk
load_model_checkpoint: load a model checkpoint from disk including model weights, optimizer, EMA, and scheduler state
log_training_samples: log generated audio samples during training by running inference and saving WAV files to disk
